def bookings_on(self, day):
    result = []
    for i in range(self.used):
        booking = self.bookings[i]
        if booking.start_day == day:
            result.append(booking)
    return result
from types import SimpleNamespace as N
a=N(start_day="2027-01-03");b=N(start_day="2027-01-04");d=N(bookings=[a,b,None],used=2)

assert bookings_on(d,"2027-02-01")==[]
